answer: Audits are recorded in relic, queued in ivory, and atlas publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 12 identities per epoch. A farm of 141 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3041 identities would post 1932 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
